hypothesis: Four public lifecycle contracts can replace repeated registration and state-query setup while retaining concrete registration, query, removal and session-isolation assertions. The 16 matcher cases and command, HTTP and skillRoot boundaries remain independent. This intentionally merges case identities; assertion counts alone cannot establish equivalence, so capability comparisons and semantic review are required.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager addFunctionHook should add a function hook and return hook ID
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: Registration with no options must return a defined generated hook ID, and hasSessionHooks is true immediately afterward; the lifecycle subsequently removes that hook.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager addFunctionHook should use provided hook ID
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle queries custom hooks across events in fresh arrays and removes them by ID
mappings.reason: Registration must return custom-hook-id; event and all-session queries must expose that exact ID before removal.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager addFunctionHook should add hook with options
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: After the first hook is removed, registration with options but no custom ID must produce a one-element event array containing My Hook, timeout 30000, description Test hook, error message Test error message, function type and the returned ID.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager removeFunctionHook should remove hook by ID
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: Removing the only registered hook by session, event and returned ID must return true, after which hasSessionHooks is false.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager removeFunctionHook should return false for non-existent hook
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle reports empty queries and failed removal before registration
mappings.reason: Before any registration, removing non-existent from session-1 and PreToolUse still returns false.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager removeHook should remove hook by ID across all events
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: ID-only removal receives the generated configured hook ID and must return true; the session then has no hooks. The cross-event contract additionally checks ID-only removal of concrete IDs from PostToolUse, Stop and PreToolUse.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getHooksForEvent should return hooks for specific event
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle queries custom hooks across events in fresh arrays and removes them by ID
mappings.reason: PreToolUse and PostToolUse each return exactly their concrete hook ID while both events coexist.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getHooksForEvent should return empty array for non-existent session
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle reports empty queries and failed removal before registration
mappings.reason: Querying PreToolUse before session-1 exists still returns an empty array.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager hasSessionHooks should return true when session has hooks
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: hasSessionHooks is explicitly true immediately after registering the generated hook.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager hasSessionHooks should return false when session has no hooks
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle reports empty queries and failed removal before registration
mappings.reason: hasSessionHooks is explicitly false before any hook is registered.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager hasSessionHooks should return false after all hooks removed
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle registers generated hooks, removes by event and preserves options
mappings.reason: After ID-only removal of the only remaining generated hook, hasSessionHooks must be false; the cross-event contract also checks the empty result after three removals.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager clearSessionHooks should clear all hooks for a session
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle enumerates sessions and clears every event in only the selected session
mappings.reason: PreToolUse and PostToolUse are populated before clearSessionHooks; afterward hasSessionHooks is false and getAllSessionHooks returns an empty array.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager clearSessionHooks should not affect other sessions
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle enumerates sessions and clears every event in only the selected session
mappings.reason: Clearing session-1 leaves session-2 present with exactly other-hook-id, while session-1 has no hooks.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getActiveSessions should return all session IDs with hooks
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle enumerates sessions and clears every event in only the selected session
mappings.reason: Before clearing, the sorted active-session list is exactly session-1 and session-2; afterward only session-2 remains.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getHookCount should return correct hook count
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle queries custom hooks across events in fresh arrays and removes them by ID
mappings.reason: With one PreToolUse and one PostToolUse hook the count is explicitly 2; after adding Stop and removing PostToolUse it is again explicitly 2.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getHookCount should return 0 for non-existent session
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle reports empty queries and failed removal before registration
mappings.reason: The hook count for session-1 before registration is explicitly 0.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getAllSessionHooks should return empty array for non-existent session
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle reports empty queries and failed removal before registration
mappings.reason: The all-session query before session-1 exists still returns an empty array.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getAllSessionHooks should return all hooks across all events
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle queries custom hooks across events in fresh arrays and removes them by ID
mappings.reason: The all-session query must contain exactly the three concrete hook-ID/event pairs for PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop.

mappings.before: SessionHooksManager getAllSessionHooks should return copy of hooks array
mappings.after: SessionHooksManager session lifecycle queries custom hooks across events in fresh arrays and removes them by ID
mappings.reason: With only the first hook and its event registered, two all-session queries retain distinct array references and equal contents; the first array must contain exactly custom-hook-id. Keeping the single-event fixture guards against a single-event optimization returning the internal array.
